notes.title: Third update
notes.content:

notes.title: Second update
notes.content:
In order to comply with Steam's regulations, the game body will no longer display pornographic, bare content. Made some adjustments.

1. Move the original pornographic and bare parts into the free DLC.
2, in the DLC added a small game DPS mode

Optimization section
1. Fixed some situations in which some terrains could not be resourced.
2, corrected some of the statements are not smooth
